mapper.sql: FROM quotations INNER JOIN users ON users.id = quotations.created_by INNER JOIN customers ON customers.id = quotations.customer_id INNER JOIN currency_centers ON currency_centers.id = quotations.currency_center_id
mapper.select:
( SELECT 1 AS type, products.name AS itemName, products.code AS sku, products.barcode AS upc, quotation_details.qty AS qty, uoms.name AS uomName, quotation_details.unit_price AS unitCost, quotation_details.total_price AS totalCost FROM quotation_details INNER JOIN products ON products.id = quotation_details.product_id LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = quotation_details.qty_uom_id WHERE quotation_details.quotation_id = #{quotationId} AND quotation_details.is_break = 0 )
UNION ALL
( SELECT 2 AS `type`, services.name AS itemName, services.sku AS sku, services.sku AS upc, quotation_services.qty AS qty, NULL AS uomName, quotation_services.unit_price AS unitCost, quotation_services.total_price AS totalCost FROM quotation_services INNER JOIN services ON services.id = quotation_services.service_id WHERE quotation_services.quotation_id = #{quotationId} )

SELECT products.id AS id, quotations.quotation_date AS quotationDate, quotations.quotation_code AS quotationCode, CONCAT(customers.name_kh, ' (', customers.name, ')') AS organizationName, products.name AS itemName, products.code AS sku, products.barcode AS upc, quotation_details.qty AS qty, uoms.name AS uomName, quotation_details.unit_cost AS unitCost, quotation_details.total_price AS totalCost FROM quotations INNER JOIN users ON users.id = quotations.created_by INNER JOIN customers ON customers.id = quotations.customer_id INNER JOIN currency_centers ON currency_centers.id = quotations.currency_center_id LEFT JOIN quotation_details ON quotation_details.quotation_id = quotations.id LEFT JOIN quotation_services ON quotation_services.quotation_id = quotations.id LEFT JOIN products ON products.id = quotation_details.product_id LEFT JOIN services ON services.id = quotation_services.service_id LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = quotation_details.qty_uom_id
LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}

SELECT COUNT(products.id) FROM quotations INNER JOIN users ON users.id = quotations.created_by INNER JOIN customers ON customers.id = quotations.customer_id INNER JOIN currency_centers ON currency_centers.id = quotations.currency_center_id LEFT JOIN quotation_details ON quotation_details.quotation_id = quotations.id LEFT JOIN quotation_services ON quotation_services.quotation_id = quotations.id LEFT JOIN products ON products.id = quotation_details.product_id LEFT JOIN services ON services.id = quotation_services.service_id LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = quotation_details.qty_uom_id
